description: This file contains implementation of classes and methods related to parsing text and file paths within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It defines methods for reading text segments, parsing file paths, and extracting components like drive, filename, extension, and path.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class for parsing text segments with methods to read text based on delimiters and manage internal position.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class for parsing file paths into drive, path, filename, extension, and base filename components.

methods.name: TextParser::ReadText
methods.description: Reads a text segment up to a delimiter or quote, returning the endpoint position.

methods.name: TextParser::ReadText (overload)
methods.description: Reads a text segment into a result object, updating the parser position.

methods.name: PathParser::Parse
methods.description: Parses a file path into its components: drive, path, filename, extension, and base filename.
